visual_notes: Chart showing Mean KL divergence vs BF16 for different quantization levels of Qwen3.8-27B, demonstrating the efficiency of Dynamic Quants.
important_information: Dynamic Quants allow Qwen3.8-27B to be compressed from 8-bit (28.9GB) to 1-bit (8.5GB).
The model maintains high performance (92.4% next token match) despite significant compression.
ocr_text: Atomic has released Dynamic Quants for Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF, a quantized version of Qwen3.8 27B, compressed from 8-bit (28.9GB) to 1-bit (8.5GB). Qwen 3.8 27B held-out 2x RTX 5090 CUDA 13.0
